memberdef.name: DEF_ABSTRACT_LOCK

briefdescription.para: Initializes the given vlistset_t object lst.

detaileddescription.para:
> Note: must be called before threads access the listset.
lst
address of vlistset_t object.
retire_fun
address of the function used to retire removed nodes.
retire_fun_arg
optional second parameter to pass to retire_fun.
cmp_fun
address of the function used for comparing a key in vlistset_node_t object with a given key.

briefdescription.para: Destroys all the remaining nodes in the listset.

detaileddescription.para:
> Note: call only after thread join, or after all threads finished accessing the given vlistset_t object.
lst
address of vlistset_t object.

briefdescription.para: Inserts the given node into the listset.

detaileddescription.para: The node is only inserted if there is no other node associated with the given key exists in the listset.

> Note: if the operation fails, users can safely free or reuse the given node.
the key must be set in the given node before calling add.
lst
address of vlistset_t object.
key
the key value that is used to identify the node.
node
address of vlistset_node_t object.
true operation succeeded, the given node has been added.
false operation failed, the given node has not been added, because there exists another node associated with the given key.
> Note: must be called inside SMR critical section.

briefdescription.para: Removes the node associated with the given key from the listset.

detaileddescription.para:
> Note: the registered retire callback will be called on the removed node.
lst
address of vlistset_t object.
key
the key identifying the node to remove.
true the node associated with the given key was removed successfully.
false could not find a node holding the given key to remove.
> Note: must be called inside SMR critical section.

briefdescription.para: Looks for the listset node associated with the given key.

detaileddescription.para:
lst
address of vlistset_t object.
key
key value.
vlistset_node_t* address of the listset node associated with the given key.
NULL if no node associated with the given key was found.
> Note: must be called inside SMR critical section.

briefdescription.para: Visits all nodes in the list and calls visitor on them.

detaileddescription.para:
> Note: call only after thread join, or after all threads finished accessing the given vlistset_t object.
lst
address of vlistset_t object.
visitor
address of the function to call on each node.
arg
second argument of visitor.
visitor_destructive
true: visitor is destructive. false: visitor is not destructive.

briefdescription.para: This implementation of listset uses one lock to serialize all operations.

detaileddescription.para: > Note: SMR usage is required only in the scenario where users access the node returned by vlistset_get, which happens without lock protection. The node might then get deleted by a parallel vlistset_remove operation. If the user does not wish to access the node itself, and uses vlistset_get only to check if a node exists, then SMR is not necessary as long as no dereferencing of the returned address occurs.
Maurice Herlihy, Nir Shavit - [The Art of Multiprocessor Programming 9.4] (https://dl.acm.org/doi/pdf/10.5555/2385452)
